record.paper_title: Several Open Problems on Banach Spaces (Castro Urdiales 2014)
record.original_question: Let E be a reflexive separable Banach lattice. Must E contain a disjoint sequence that spans a complemented subspace of E?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E$ be a reflexive separable Banach lattice. Recall that a sequence $(x_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ in $E$ is called disjoint if $|x_n|\wedge|x_m|=0$ whenever $n\neq m$, and a closed subspace $F\subseteq E$ is complemented if there exists a bounded linear projection from $E$ onto $F$. 

Must $E$ contain a disjoint sequence $(x_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ of nonzero elements whose closed linear span $\overline{\operatorname{span}}\{x_n:n\in\mathbb{N}\}$ is a complemented subspace of $E$?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work on disjointly homogeneous and disjointly complemented Banach lattices (e.g., Flores–Hernández–Tradacete and the 2025 survey "Complemented subspaces of Banach lattices" by de Hevia and Tradacete) treats the existence of disjoint sequences with complemented span as an active structural question. No reference found that resolves the question for general reflexive separable Banach lattices, so it appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Complemented subspaces of Banach lattices (de Hevia, Tradacete)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey/research on when subspaces of Banach lattices, including spans of disjoint sequences, are complemented.
status_evidence.claim: The structural question of when disjoint sequences span complemented subspaces is an active topic with no general resolution cited for reflexive separable Banach lattices.

status_evidence.title: Disjointly homogeneous Banach lattices: Duality and complementation
status_evidence.snippet: Studies disjointly complemented (DC) Banach lattices: every disjoint sequence has a subsequence with complemented span, and identifies sufficient conditions (e.g., DH plus DH dual).
status_evidence.claim: Only partial sufficient conditions (such as disjoint homogeneity of E and E*) are known to ensure complemented spans of disjoint sequences.
